title: 初一听对话判断：演出服箱子
instruction: 听完整对话，判断四个陈述正误，选T（正确）或F（错误）。本机音轨内对话一遍，可自行重播；来源未规定统一重播次数，不当成考试只能听一次。
audio_introduction: Listen to the conversation. Nina, Toby and Leo are getting ready for a school play. Read the four statements. Choose true or false.

clips.context: Nina, Toby and Leo are getting ready for a school play.

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Toby, do we have all the clothes for the play?

turns.speaker: T
turns.text: Yes, Nina. There are two boxes here. The blue box has the hats, and the red one has the coats.

turns.speaker: L
turns.text: I can carry both boxes to the hall.

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Thank you, Leo, but the red one is heavy. Let us carry that one together.

turns.speaker: T
turns.text: I will take the blue box. Are we going through the garden?

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: No. It is raining now. We can use the inside stairs.

turns.speaker: L
turns.text: Fine. Let us move the boxes before the other pupils arrive.

questions.stem: The hats are in the red box.
questions.rationale: 原录音说blue box has the hats；红盒装coats，因此T与收纳位置冲突。

questions.stem: Nina and Leo plan to carry the red box together.
questions.rationale: Nina拒绝Leo独搬、明确let us carry that one together，双方共同搬；F与计划冲突。

questions.stem: The children decide to go through the garden.
questions.rationale: Nina因下雨否定garden路线，提出inside stairs；T与明确路线冲突。

questions.stem: The other pupils have not arrived yet.
questions.rationale: Leo提出在其他同学到达之前搬，说明此刻尚未到；F改变时序。
